# Motion

AuraGlass motion is spring-first: every enter/exit/press runs on a damped
spring compiled to a `linear()` easing at build time; durations and bezier
easings cover the few non-physical transitions. The tables below are generated
from `src/motion/tokens.generated.ts` — the numbers are never hand-maintained.

## Durations

| Token | ms | Use |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `--ag-duration-ambient` | 40000 | continuous-only (shimmer/lens drift) |
| `--ag-duration-instant` | 90 | enter/state transitions |
| `--ag-duration-instant-exit` | 60 | exit transitions |
| `--ag-duration-large` | 450 | enter/state transitions |
| `--ag-duration-large-exit` | 320 | exit transitions |
| `--ag-duration-medium` | 320 | enter/state transitions |
| `--ag-duration-medium-exit` | 220 | exit transitions |
| `--ag-duration-micro` | 120 | enter/state transitions |
| `--ag-duration-micro-exit` | 80 | exit transitions |
| `--ag-duration-small` | 200 | enter/state transitions |
| `--ag-duration-small-exit` | 140 | exit transitions |

## Easings

| Token | Cubic bezier |
| --- | --- |
| `--ag-ease-accelerate` | `cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 1, 1)` |
| `--ag-ease-emphasized` | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` |
| `--ag-ease-emphasized-decelerate` | `cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1)` |
| `--ag-ease-standard` | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` |

## Springs (compiled `linear()`)

| Token | Settle (ms) | Stops | ζ | response (s) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `--ag-spring-fluid` | 700 | 21 | 0.82 | 0.45 |
| `--ag-spring-smooth` | 520 | 20 | 0.9 | 0.35 |
| `--ag-spring-snappy` | 350 | 20 | 1 | 0.2 |

Spring `linear()` curves carry per-stop progress hints; |x(t) − linear(t)| ≤ 0.005
over 1,000 samples vs the analytic damped solution (tests/tokens/motion-spring.test.ts).

## Reduced motion

- `data-ag-motion="calm|none"` and `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` zero all
  transform transitions (byte-identical springs across modes — MAT-044).
- Springs' settle durations stay readable: instant exits land at
  60ms, never below.

## Human motion review (L14)

Sign-off checklist — reviewer records per-flagship verdicts in the PR:

- [ ] Specular response: highlight tracks pointer lift without lag or flutter.
- [ ] Materialization: glass cells blur-in/scale-in on the snappy spring (350ms), never bounce.
- [ ] No press scale: press feedback is rim/glow + specular only (SC-38).
- [ ] Continuous ambient motion (40000ms loop) invisible under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
